description: PopUp-Sim provides a microscopic simulation of pop-up retrofitting sites for digital automatic coupler migration in European freight rail. The provider is OpenRail Association / PopUpSim project. Geographical and temporal coverage: The tool models a planned migration programme and scenario windows, not completed future retrofits. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Apache-2.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Future wagon counts and migration dates are planning assumptions; the README also records a pinned dependency to avoid a Windows fault. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
